sonicpi.title: Sonic Pi bundled samples
sonicpi.author: Freesound contributors / The Black Dog (see Sonic Pi samples README)

sfx.name: phone_pickup
sfx.plan: recorded layers + synthesis: plastic handling (Oculus plastic drops), switch clicks and cloth; line-open click and noise floor synthesized

sfx.name: pen_click
sfx.plan: recorded layers: small plastic/mechanical clicks (Oculus switches, clickety clips, Kenney); pair two clicks 60-90 ms apart

sfx.name: door_creak
sfx.plan: recorded: door open/close creaks (qubodup sets, Kenney RPG creaks, OGA wood squeaks, Oculus wood doors) + CC0 double-bass bow creaks for slow horror creaks

sfx.name: glitch
sfx.plan: recorded: Sonic Pi glitch/robot, Kenney interface glitches, sci-fi computer noise; plus synthesized bit-crush stutters

sfx.name: typing
sfx.plan: recorded: 50 keystrokes / typing takes (OGA keyboard soundpack)

sfx.name: room_tone
sfx.plan: recorded: Oculus home room tones and HVAC/fan/fridge-like hums (loops); layer 2, EQ per room

sfx.name: clock_tick
sfx.plan: recorded: Oculus creepy clock ticks + loopable mechanical clock (Owlish); pitch/space per shot

sfx.name: countdown_tick
sfx.plan: recorded: stopwatch loop, Kenney UI ticks, clock ticks; tight, dry, close

sfx.name: tv_off
sfx.plan: synthesis + layers: CRT collapse (HF whine sweep down, degauss thump, static pop) synthesized; recorded switch clicks, electric powerdown/crackle and Epidemic radio static as layers

sfx.name: crowd_whisper
sfx.plan: recorded layers: whisper grains (OGA, qubodup), shh/breaths, indoor murmur and restaurant walla; stack 8-20 time/pitch-shifted copies, band-limit, pan wide

score.layer: strings harmonics / sul ponticello / col legno
